title: Nucleic acid nanotechnology in tumor microenvironment research: from illumination to intervention for enhanced immunotherapy
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2026, 55,1615-1665
DOI: 10.1039/D5CS00602C, Review Article
Jiayi Lu, Wei Zhai, Min Li, Xiaolei Zuo, Junhua Zheng, Shaopeng Wang
Nucleic acid nanotechnology provides powerful approaches for non-invasive biomarker imaging and immune modulation, offering new opportunities to illuminate and therapeutically intervene in the tumor microenvironment.
